collection.title: VW Tiguan/Tiguan Allspace 2007 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Tiguan 2007 to 2015 model requires a 24" wiper blade on both drivers side and a 21" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Tiguan, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
